definitions.explanation: A public display of works of art or items of interest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧{展覧会|てんらんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧{展覧会|てんらんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to an art exhibition.

examples.japanese: {展覧会|てんらんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought tickets to the exhibition.

notes:
{展覧会|てんらんかい} refers to a public exhibition, typically of art or cultural items.

TYPES:
- ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧{展覧会|てんらんかい}: art exhibition
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧{展覧会|てんらんかい}: photography exhibition
- ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧{展覧会|てんらんかい}: calligraphy exhibition

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold an exhibition
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to an exhibition
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出品|しゅっぴん}する→出品：11726_shuppin⟧: to exhibit at a show

FORMS:
Often shortened to ⟦{展|てん}→展：noentry⟧ in compounds: ⟦{美術展|びじゅつてん}→美術展：noentry⟧ (art exhibition)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧: display, exhibition
- ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧: art museum
